schemas.$comment: Self-contained and closed: re-declares every property action.v1 would otherwise provide and rejects any undeclared field, on itself and on its own payload.

Derived Action type for the duplicate-entry-instance stress test. Self-contained and closed: re-declares every property the base action.v1 would otherwise provide and rejects any undeclared field, on itself and on its own payload (cpt-frontx-dod-gts-type-provider-infra-schema-ownership) — no fields are added or narrowed beyond the base contract. The mediator routes by (extensionInstanceId, actionType) so an action targeted at one instance does not reach another; per-entry validation enforces that only entries declaring this action in their actions[] (fixture-a's entry) accept it.

type.$comment: Self-reference to this action's schema type ID

target.$comment: Type ID of the target extension instance

payload.$comment: No payload fields — a ping carries nothing
